description: Dashboard carousel optimization and button fixes (Tasks 1 & 2). Fix the carousel aspect ratio to 4:1 with object-fit:cover for images, add upload helper text, and fix the 'Booked Events' button navigation.
steps: In healthcamp-client/src/Home.tsx, modify the Carousel component: (a) wrap the carousel in a container with a strict 4:1 aspect ratio using CSS (aspect-ratio: 4/1 or padding-top trick), (b) change the Image component inside Carousel.Slide from h={470} to use 100% height with object-fit: cover so images fill the container without distortion, (c) add a Text element below the carousel with helper text: 'Suggested image size: 1200x300px for better fit without cropping.'

In healthcamp-client/src/Home.tsx, fix the 'Available Package' button: move the onClick handler from the MdArrowCircleRight icon to the Button itself (currently the icon has the onClick but the Button is the clickable element with disabled logic).

In healthcamp-client/src/Home.tsx, fix the 'Booked Events' button: add an onClick handler to navigate to '/events' when clicked (currently has no navigation handler). The button should navigate to the events page which shows booked events.

Polish both buttons (Available Package and Booked Events) to have consistent styling: both should use the same variant, size, and color scheme. Ensure both buttons pass the kycState disabled prop consistently.
acceptance_criteria: Carousel container is constrained to a 4:1 aspect ratio
Images inside carousel use object-fit: cover to avoid distortion
Helper text 'Suggested image size: 1200x300px for better fit without cropping.' is displayed near the carousel
Booked Events button navigates to /events when clicked
Available Package button onClick is on the Button element itself, not just the icon
Both dashboard buttons have cohesive, consistent styling
verification: Run npx tsc --noEmit in healthcamp-client directory to verify no TypeScript errors
findings: NODE_OPTIONS env var causes proxy-bootstrap.js error; must unset NODE_OPTIONS before running npx tsc --noEmit. TypeScript compilation passes cleanly with the changes.
